date_note: APP's dateline is 24 November; the page gives no earlier day.
exec: Pakistan's cybercrime agency reports recovering Rs 5.064 million for fraud victims and arresting four members of an alleged gang behind a Rs 5.809 million romance scam.
org: National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA), Pakistan
plain: Pakistan's cybercrime agency says it recovered Rs 5.064 million for fraud victims and arrested four alleged members of a gang behind a Rs 5.809 million online romance scam.
summary: APP reports that Pakistan's NCCIA has recovered Rs 5.064 million for victims of financial fraud in separate operations. It also reports that NCCIA arrested four suspects in raids in Rahim Yar Khan and Lodhran, describing them as members of an alleged gang behind a Rs 5.809 million online romance scam.
title: APP: Pakistan's NCCIA recovers Rs 5.064 million for fraud victims and arrests four over Rs 5.809 million romance scam

evidence.quote: The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) has recovered Rs 5.064 million for victims of financial fraud
arresting four members of an alleged gang involved in a Rs 5.809 million online romance scam.

validation.note: Only APP (Associated Press of Pakistan) read; it relays NCCIA's account. No NCCIA page read.
